members.name: write-A
members.prompt:
Write three backend tests for OR-3201 in the worktree `/Users/ryanducharme/dev/worktrees/OR-3201-backlog-backend-coverage` (branch `feature/OR-3201-backlog-backend-coverage`). Work ONLY in that directory.

HARD RULES:
- **Do not run `mvn` or any build.** The twelve tests for this ticket are being written by four agents in parallel in one worktree; concurrent Maven clashes on `target/`. I compile and run everything serially after you finish.
- **Do not modify any production (`src/main`) code.** If a test cannot pass without a production change, do not write it — report that instead.
- **Do not commit, push, or touch git.**
- **No code comments.** This repo forbids them (see CLAUDE.md). Clear names and obvious control flow only.
- Only touch the three files listed below. Other agents own the rest.

Read each target file (or its closest sibling if new) FIRST and match its existing style, fixtures, and base class.

YOUR THREE:

1. `orci/src/test/java/com/guided/orci/service/hl7/DefaultHL7ProcessingContextObservationDispatchTest.java` (existing, has ~5 tests)
   `saveObservations` has a per-glucose `try/catch` inside the `afterCommit` loop so one failed dispatch cannot abort the rest of an ORU's glucoses. No test covers it. Write one where the first glucose's dispatch stub throws and assert the remaining glucoses are still dispatched. The throwing stub IS the red control — without the catch, the exception escapes the commit.

2. `orci/src/test/java/com/guided/orci/services/OperationServiceTest.java` (existing)
   The `firstStart` guard has two documented halves — must not arm it, nor disarm it. Only the disarm half is tested. Write the arm-up direction. It must be the kind of test where a plausible regression (inverting the condition to `if (!isEras && followsEras)`) fails this test while the existing sibling still passes. Verify that claim by reading the production method before writing.

3. `orci/src/test/java/com/guided/orci/service/rules/RuleServiceConfigCacheRefreshTest.java` (existing)
   The class already has a fake `Ticker` and covers the remote-edit path (expire-after-write vs after-access). Untested: `saveStoredConfiguration`'s write-through `ruleConfigCache.put(...)`. Assert a local save is visible immediately AND that it restarts the 30s window. Use the existing fake Ticker so it stays deterministic.

REPORT BACK: for each of the three — the file, the test method name(s) you added, what the red control is (the specific one-line production mutation that would make it fail), and anything you could not write and why. If you decided a test was already covered after reading the file, say so and skip it rather than writing a duplicate. Keep it short.
